AGO.note: Angola supplies the satellite; the document states no Angolan rural access programme or rural-urban figures.

facts.fact: Namibia's Ministry of Information and Communication Technology partnered with Angola to use the Angosat-2 satellite, with a proof of concept begun in June 2025, to explore broadband Internet and voice services for remote areas lacking terrestrial infrastructure.

systems.owner: Namibia MICT with Telecom Namibia and Angola's GGPEN
